newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA SELLS CONFECTIONER,BUYS TECHNOLOGY FIRM.
newsitem.headline: NSA SELLS CONFECTIONER,BUYS TECHNOLOGY FIRM.

text.p: Investment trust firm NSA Investments Ltd said on Monday it planned to sell its 45 percent shareholding in Pepe Confectioners and make a new investment worth more than 20 million rand.

In a newspaper announcement, NSA said it had disposed of its investment in Pepe for 72 million rand and acquired a 34 percent equity interest in technology group IST Holdings (Pty) from IMS Holdings (Pty) and minority shareholders for 13 million rand.
As part of the same deal, NSA unit Coordinated Network Investments (Pty) had acquired about 26 percent of IST for around 10 million rand.
The IST acquisition formed part of the NSA group's overall strategy to invest in emergent hi-tech technology growth businesses with strong management, NSA said.
